title: VnExpress Marathon Nha Trang 2026 Review: What the Fifth Edition Was Like
seo_title: VnExpress Marathon Nha Trang 2026 Review | Khanh Hoa
meta_description: VnExpress Marathon Nha Trang 2026 review: 10,000 runners from 2-4 Square on 9 August, a seafront route on Tran Phu and a climb over Luong Son Pass.
dek: The fifth VnExpress Marathon Nha Trang put 10,000 runners on the seafront on 9 August 2026. Here is what the race was like, from the report on it.
verdict: VnExpress Marathon Nha Trang is a big seaside race that has used the same start and finish in front of 2-4 Square for years. The 2026 race, on 9 August, drew 10,000 runners across the marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km, all starting and finishing at 2-4 Square [1]. The shorter races stay on Tran Phu Street along the beach, and the longer ones head north over Luong Son Pass [1]. The race ran for more than six hours, and it was part of the Khanh Hoa Sea Festival [1]. If you want a large, well-established Vietnamese race by the sea, this is a reliable one. The pass is the part to train for.

sections.heading: The 2026 Edition
paragraphs: The fifth edition started at 2-4 Square in Nha Trang on 9 August 2026 and drew 10,000 runners from across Vietnam [1]. As in previous years, both start and finish were in front of the square [1].
There were four distances: 42 km, 21 km, 10 km and 5 km [1]. The race ran for more than six hours before the awards [1], and it was held as part of the Khanh Hoa Sea Festival 2026 [1].

sections.heading: The Routes
paragraphs: The marathon ran along Tran Phu Street, Le Thanh Ton and Nguyen Trai, beside the Quan Truong River, then out along Pham Van Dong Street and over Luong Son Pass [1]. The half marathon used Tran Phu, Pham Van Dong and Luong Son Pass [1].

The 10 km ran along Tran Phu Street, the beachfront road, and turned near the Vo Thi Sau and Vinpearl junction, and the 5 km turned opposite the Naval Academy [1]. For those distances this is a flat seafront out-and-back. For the half and full marathon, the pass is the main climb.

sections.heading: Should You Enter Next Year?
paragraphs: If you want a big Vietnamese race in a beach city, with 10,000 runners and a festival around it, yes. Five editions in, it is an established fixture.
Choose your distance by the pass. The 10 km and 5 km are seafront runs, while the 21 km and 42 km include Luong Son Pass, which changes how you should pace them.
This review is compiled from a published report on the 2026 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran VnExpress Marathon Nha Trang in 2026?
faqs.answer: 10,000 runners from across Vietnam took part in the fifth edition on 9 August 2026, across the 42 km, 21 km, 10 km and 5 km. All distances started and finished in front of 2-4 Square in Nha Trang.

faqs.question: What is the VnExpress Marathon Nha Trang route like?
faqs.answer: The 10 km and 5 km are out-and-back runs along Tran Phu, Nha Trang's beachfront road. The half and full marathons head north along Pham Van Dong Street and over Luong Son Pass, and the marathon also runs through the city beside the Quan Truong River.

faqs.question: When is VnExpress Marathon Nha Trang held?
faqs.answer: In early August. The 2026 edition was on 9 August and was part of the Khanh Hoa Sea Festival. 2026 was the fifth edition.
